# Preface

## About

This is an Open Educational Resource (OER) textbook on introductory statistics for audience of undergraduate students who have taken calculus. The book was written in R Markdown with the `bookdown` package [@xie2015]. We have claimed an [MIT License](https://opensource.org/license/mit/), which enables users to freely access, modify, and share the content while adhering to the license's terms. 

## R

We use the `R` programming language throughout the book for data analysis, visualization, and computation. You can download the base version of `R` and view extensive documentation at the [Comprehensive R Archive Network (CRAN)](https://cran.r-project.org/) website. `RStudio` is an integrated development environment (IDE) that many people find easier to use than base `R`. You can download `RStudio` and access many training materials at the [RStudio website](https://www.rstudio.com/). There is a wide array of excellent resources for learning `R`, including the [DataCamp](https://www.datacamp.com/) and [Coursera](https://www.coursera.org/) online learning repositories and the book *R for Data Science* [@RDataScience].

## Supplemental Resources

All data (and associated `R` code) can be obtained from the book's GitHub repository. Also at GitHub are standalone `R` "scripts" containing code for e.g. simulations. 

## Acknowledgements

We thank Trey Turner, Craig Cabrera, Drew Kearny, Aditya Kovilur, Rebecca Lee, and Yunhe Liu for their assistance with obtaining data sets, writing `R` code, and creating exercises.
